name: Gabri
epithet: Wielder of the Flame of Mercolas
bio: White garb, black leather under it, and a sword that lights when he needs it to. Gabri holds complete lawful immunity in every case but one, and he uses it the way most men use a key -- he does not knock, he does not haggle, and he does not sit on a lead he could walk to and look at himself. Ask him a hard question and he answers it in as few words as it takes: 'Big,' when a minister wants to know how bad the news is; 'Wrong,' with his hand already at a Y'marr's throat. He has stood back up mid-slaughter and kept fighting from the floor rather than lose the room, and he has put a blade through a locked door rather than pick it. What the Flame has not taught his hands yet, his hands are going to learn the slow way, same as anyone's.
selfIntro: Gabri. Wielder of the Flame of Mercolas, for what that is worth to you standing here. I am not going to charm you and I am not going to threaten you -- I am going to ask you what happened, and then I am going to go and look at it myself. Tell me straight and we will get on fine.

chargenPreset._schema: native/include/granadad/sim/chargen.hpp -- SkillDesignation::Primary/Major/Minor over the 19 non-the_flame ids in content/raws/skills/skills.json, the same schema content/raws/companions/devin.json uses. 3 Primary slots, 3 Major, and this sheet fills only 5 of the 6 Minor -- see the rationale's own note on why the sixth is left empty rather than forced. Starting level per tier is the engine's own kPrimaryStartLevel=30 / kMajorStartLevel=15 / kMinorStartLevel=5, not authored here twice. Untouched ids are left at whatever SkillTrack already has them (0 for a fresh arrival). the_flame cannot be designated at all -- Chargen::designate refuses any skill whose raws aptitudeTier is Flame (chargen.cpp), so it is not listed in any tier below; PROGRESSION-SPEC.md section 7 rules it locked at start for everyone, Wielder included.
chargenPreset.attributeBonusSpendNote: Sums to kAttributeBonusPool=24 exactly; no single value exceeds kAttributeBonusPerAttributeCap=15. Applied on top of kAttributeBase=40 by Chargen::apply(), so this preset resolves to MGT 50, AGI 40, VIG 54, WIT 40 -- Vigor and Might carry the whole spend, Agility and Wit left exactly at the floor. That is 'no-nonsense' as the starkest possible attribute read: all the finesse a fast or clever build would buy is worth nothing to a man who solves problems by walking through the door, so none of the pool goes there. Contrast devin.json's own AGI 52 / WIT 48 lean, built for range and reading a room rather than for standing in the open and taking a hit.

chargenPresetRationale.why: the single skill this sheet invests most in on purpose. Knocked down mid-slaughter in the crypt and keeps killing from the floor rather than lose the room (novel L2703-L2718) -- the one canon feat 'no-nonsense' has no other honest place to put, and the clearest possible contrast with a template built around not being hit at all.

his signature and only named weapon -- the flaming sword, drawn and used without hesitation from his very introduction (L2340-2345) through the crypt (L2710, L2713) to Golath's chamber (L2718-2744). Gabri is never shown carrying anything else.

'black leather under' the white robes (L2340) is real worn protection, not clergy cloth for its own sake -- the one of the crypt's three actually kitted to take a hit (contrast Devin's bare apprentice grays, L2969, and this file's own bio).

grabs Devin bodily out of a strike's path in the same beat he is already fighting with the sword (L2710) -- a hand free to do that under pressure is a body that has some unarmed competence, even though the novel never puts him in a fight on his hands alone.

no direct citation. A blade that has to relight and a cathedral that keeps everyone's gear implies routine upkeep somewhere; kept Major rather than Primary for exactly that honesty -- there is no page that shows him doing it, the same standard devin.json's own kit_keeping entry (which DOES have a citation, L2715) is held to.

invented, needs-blessing: a small, plausible pre-Flame familiarity with moving charge -- ordinary monastic study on the way to the Vigil rite that unlocks the_flame itself (PROGRESSION-SPEC.md section 7), not the Flame's own power. Kept modest and Major rather than higher on purpose: this is proximity to the Flame, never a substitute for it.

no citation and no thematic tie -- that repeater is Devin's kit, never Gabri's own (skills.json's own canonAnchor for this skill cites Devin's crossbow, not the Wielder). Kept Minor rather than 0 as the plainest 'a soldier-adjacent life leaves some baseline exposure' reading, and kept far below bladework so the sword stays his one unambiguous weapon.
Vallech/the Sky Knights' weapon, not his -- no canon tie. Minor for the identical baseline-exposure reason as sidearms above, nothing more claimed.
the Trojian house-guard axe and Devin's own mace live here (skills.json's canonAnchor); Gabri is shown wielding neither. Minor, same baseline reasoning.

no citation, no tie -- a different weapon family from the sword he actually carries. Minor, same baseline reasoning, and deliberately not 0 for the same reason none of this quintet is: a life spent around soldiers and Blademaster journeymen (skills.json's own trainer roster, PROGRESSION-SPEC.md section 6) plausibly rubs off a little on everything, just never enough to specialize.

no citation -- Gabri is never shown carrying a shield, and canon's own shieldman drill (skills.json's citation) belongs to rank-and-file soldiers, not a Wielder. Minor, same baseline reasoning, and the last of the five that keeps the Minor tier honestly thin (5 of 6 slots) rather than padded to a round number -- see the note below.

DELIBERATE, the strongest single zero on this whole sheet. He does not pick locks -- he burns them: 'he stabbed his flaming sword through the door' (L2718), canon-explicit and the exact opposite of Devin's own Primary pick on this same skill.

DELIBERATE. Full lawful immunity means he never has to be unseen; every entry in the novel -- the abbey, the crypt, the palace -- is a front door he simply walks through. Contrast Devin's own Primary pick here for the identical, opposite reason PROGRESSION-SPEC.md section 2's own #10 entry already states: Gabri's rooftop access is a privilege his immunity buys with no stealth required, Devin has no such immunity and actually needs it.

DELIBERATE, and not this file's invention -- PROGRESSION-SPEC.md section 2's own north-star guard states the exact number in these words: 'A Streetwise 0 Gabri is still obeyed everywhere but pays list price, knows nothing about the Darkstreets, and never sees a patrol coming; that gap is the skill.'
not his register anywhere in the novel -- he brews nothing, drugs nothing, poisons nothing. The Flame is direct force; venoms and draughts are somebody else's toolkit entirely.

DELIBERATE. A Wielder with the real Flame of Mercolas has no use for the weak, public-shelf book-magic linkcraft gates (docs/lore/MAGIC-CANON.md, skills.json's own canonAnchor) -- the opposite pole from Devin's own Minor pick here, which is exactly the point: linkcraft is the unglamorous, earned register a studious outsider reaches for, and Gabri was never that outsider.
no canon tie, no thematic tie -- an urban Wielder answering to the Granadad cathedral has no call to have farmed a courtyard plot.

no canon tie, no thematic tie -- nothing in the novel puts him on a hull, and unlike Devin (carried across the sea as a child, L2406) there is no harbor-childhood reading available for Gabri to borrow.

no canon tie, no thematic tie, and left at 0 rather than forced into the Minor tier's last slot -- see the note below on why this sheet fills only 5 of 6 Minor picks instead of inventing a sixth 'thinnest-justified pick' the way devin.json's own fishing/seacraft entries (which ARE Minor) honestly flag having to do.

minorSlotNote: This sheet designates only 5 of chargen.hpp's 6 Minor slots -- Chargen::apply() and Chargen::skillsComplete() both work correctly with any subset of the sheet designated (chargen.hpp's own header, and render/creation.hpp's canConfirm() is deliberately not gated on skillsComplete() for exactly this reason), so leaving one slot empty is a legal, unpenalized choice, not an error. It is made on purpose here: every remaining candidate for a sixth Minor pick (fieldcraft, seacraft, fishing) has no canon tie and no thematic tie to Gabri at all, and devin.json's own fishing/seacraft rationale already names picking one of those anyway as the 'thinnest-justified pick' its own sheet had to make to hit exactly 6. Gabri's sheet does not have to hit 6, so it does not manufacture a thirteenth invention to get there -- a fully no-nonsense reading of the tier itself: he has five ordinary, honestly-argued baseline competencies and nothing thinner than that.
presenceNote: PROGRESSION-SPEC.md section 5 sets Presence STATIC 100 as 'the Wielder's social weight... a constant of the world' -- a fact about HOLDING THE TITLE, not a generic player attribute; attributes.hpp's AttributeBlock (the real chargen engine's attribute container) holds exactly four values, MGT/AGI/VIG/WIT, with no fifth PRESENCE slot at all, which is why this sheet carries the number as its own top-level presenceAtStart field rather than inside attributeBonusSpend. Gabri IS the Wielder, textually and by office (L2340: 'I am Gabri, wielder of the flame of Mercolas'; L2967: 'complete lawful immunity in every case'), so this is the one number on this sheet that is not weak-start by design and not this file's invention -- it is the design doc's own already-ruled fact, restated. Contrast devin.json's own presenceNote, which reasons through the identical formula to the opposite, textually-supported conclusion for a companion who holds no such title.
canonAnchor: novel L2340-2345 (self-introduction over the girl he has just pulled clear of Zradist: 'I am Gabri, wielder of the flame of Mercolas', white garb, burning blade, gives the order and trusts it followed without a second word); L2409-2427 ('Big,' he said simply -- the whole of his answer to how bad the news is; walks in on the minister unannounced, novel says outright Devin thinks he 'enjoys his complete lawful immunity'); L2703-2718 (crypt fight: knocked down mid-slaughter, keeps killing from the floor rather than lose the room, no hesitation and no debate; grabs Devin clear of a strike, L2710); L2717 ('trust the Flame' is the whole of what he tells a shaking Devin, not a longer reassurance); L2718 (does not knock -- stabs the flaming sword through a locked door rather than pick it, canon-explicit); L2736-2752 (freeing Golath/Vallech: states his reasoning once, in one sentence -- 'my power was not given to me so that I could judge the wicked... it is to free them' -- and acts on it without asking permission); L2966-2980 (kicks in Bledhreft's door with no warrant, no announcement and no argument). Cross-doc anchors: PROGRESSION-SPEC.md section 2's skill table (governingAttribute/aptitudeTier columns are already authored AS Gabri's own aptitude -- 'Apt = Gabri's aptitude', that section's own header note); section 2's own north-star guard on Streetwise (quoted verbatim in this file's own rationale above); section 7 ('Locked at start... Unlock rite'); section 5 (Presence 'STATIC 100', quoted above). docs/design/DEVIN-TEMPLATE.md is the full writeup for the counterpart sheet this file was rebuilt to match schema-for-schema.
provenance: Eli named the archetype pair 'Devin (secretive) and Gabri (no-nonsense)' as BG3/Divinity-Original-Sin-2-style origin templates alongside a fully custom path (task #80). This file originally shipped with a flat startingSkills/derivedAttributesAtStart table computed by hand against PROGRESSION-SPEC.md section 5's skill-weighted-sum formula -- a real, correct arithmetic on its own terms, but a SECOND, parallel model to the chargenPreset schema content/raws/companions/devin.json adopted once native/include/granadad/sim/chargen.hpp and attributes.hpp were discovered to already implement a different, ALREADY-WIRED Primary/Major/Minor-plus-bonus-pool engine (see devin.json's own provenance and notes fields for that discovery, told from its side). This revision rebuilds Gabri's sheet on the SAME chargenPreset schema, skill-for-skill re-reasoned rather than mechanically re-mapped from the old numbers, so that native/src/sim/companions.cpp has exactly one schema to parse for both templates and the CUSTOM path, chargen.hpp's real engine, and these two fixed sheets all share one arithmetic with nothing left to drift. Every pick and every point of attribute spend is PLACEHOLDER, NEEDS-BLESSING, matching house convention for every other invented number in PROGRESSION-SPEC.md, except where canonAnchor above cites an already-ruled fact (streetwise, the_flame, presenceAtStart, and every skill/aptitude carried over unedited from skills.json's own aptitudeTier column). appearanceType: priest_of_the_flame is the closest of sim/appearance.hpp's eleven playable looks to 'clothes of pure white' (L2340) -- the same WardType/ActorSheet vocabulary the ward's own billboards use, not a separate art system; no face_named_gabri portrait exists yet (FACES-SPEC.md section 2 has shipped only face_named_devin and face_named_john), a real gap flagged here for whoever wires this template into a running game.
notes: NOT YET WIRED INTO A RUNNING GAME, beyond render/creation.hpp's own CreationFlow, which already loads this file through sim::CompanionTemplate and reads its resolved skill levels and attributes onto the GABRI customize card (see that file's own header). What remains: nothing in src/client/main.cpp yet turns a confirmed CreationResult into a spawned Session with these starting numbers actually applied to a live SkillTrack -- CompanionTemplate::applyStartingSkills(track) exists and is tested (tests/test_companions.cpp) for exactly that call, whenever the boot sequence that would make it is built. Schema mirrors devin.json field-for-field (chargenPreset/chargenPresetRationale/presenceAtStart+presenceNote/canonAnchor/provenance/notes), plus one addition neither devin.json nor chargen.hpp/attributes.hpp touch: appearanceType, sim/appearance.hpp's eleven-option ward-sprite vocabulary. devin.json remains unedited by this pass; giving Devin the same field is that file's own author's call.
